def mod_pow(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    P, K = map(int, input().split())

    MOD = 1000000007

    if K == 0:
        print(mod_pow(P, P - 1, MOD))
        return
    if K == 1:
        print(mod_pow(P, P, MOD))
        return

    visited = [False] * P
    count = 0
    p = 1
    while not visited[p]:
        visited[p] = True
        count += 1
        p = (K * p) % P

    print(mod_pow(P, count, MOD))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
